key.name: toggle-recording
key.description: Accelerator to start or stop a recording session

key.name: cancel-recording
key.description: Accelerator to cancel an in-progress recording without transcribing

key.name: auto-paste
key.description: Automatically paste the transcription result into the focused window. Terminals receive Ctrl+Shift+V; all other windows receive Ctrl+V.

key.name: direct-injection
key.description: Type text directly into the focused window instead of pasting from clipboard.
